Subject: Post-call recap: please provide buy-committee list, procurement & security contacts

Hi Patrick — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move to a short internal review on our side and get you the security/procurement artifacts you mentioned.

Summary of the call:
- Use case: Clinical documentation assistant for outpatient clinics (notes summarization + template suggestions).
- Expected initial scope: ~10 clinics, pilot 3 months, ~5000 patient encounters/month.
- Key success criteria: 95% coverage on clinical note sections, <200ms mean token latency for autocomplete flows, and clear data handling boundary for PHI.

Asks / next steps from your team:
1) Please send over the buy-committee roster (names + roles) — who is the economic buyer, technical reviewer, security/compliance owner, legal lead, and procurement contact?
2) Can you confirm the procurement intake steps (purchase order vs. contract + sproc times) and approximate timeline for procurement/legal review?
3) Please introduce the security/compliance contact or share the email so we can route our SOC2 and data handling docs directly.

Attachments: call-recording-20260823.mp3 (recording), redwood-security-brief-v2.pdf (summary of controls), procurement-intake-template.xlsx (we can prefill to speed procurement).

If easier, an org chart or a short list (Name | Title | Role in purchase | Email) is perfect. We can also join a 15-min sync with the procurement lead and your security reviewer this week if that helps.

Proposed internal next step: once we have names, Marissa will assemble an abbreviated security packet and Ben will draft a mutual action plan + draft SOW.

Thanks — Connor
